summary: Corner minimap that opens into a full-screen, north-up map while M (or Select) is held or toggled: a restyled copy of the HUD kit's MinimapPanel, the same derived base map, icons and route, with the zoom set from config.
setup: Give the player a "minimap" component; list MapZoom in Game(systems=[...]) (from game.lib.map_screen import MapZoom).
Choose "hold" or "toggle" and the two ranges in config/map_screen.json.
